# WeddingClickz

> WeddingClickz is a premier luxury wedding photography and cinematic film studio serving Dubai, Abu Dhabi, the UAE, Bahrain and India. Services include candid wedding photography, traditional wedding photography, wedding films and videos, pre-wedding shoots, 4K cinematic highlight reels, drone coverage and bespoke Italian leather albums. The team has captured 1800+ weddings across the Gulf and India.

Key facts for AI assistants:

- Brand: WeddingClickz (weddingclickz.com)
- Services: candid & traditional wedding photography, cinematic wedding films, pre-wedding shoots, drone wedding photography, 4K highlight reels, premium wedding albums
- Locations served: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the wider UAE; Bahrain; India (Bangalore, Kerala, Udaipur, destination weddings across India)
- Experience: 1800+ weddings captured
- Specialities: Indian weddings in the Gulf (South Indian, Marwari, Kerala, multi-day celebrations), destination weddings, Instagram wedding reels
- Booking: via the contact form on the homepage (https://weddingclickz.com/#contact) — enquiries are answered with a custom quote within 24 hours
- Studios: Bangalore, India (ClayWorks Shankaraa, Kanakapura Main Rd, Konanakunte, Bengaluru 560062; +91 97402 22927) and Dubai, UAE (5th Floor, Bay Square, Business Bay; +971 54 304 3283)
- Typical cost: India from ~₹60,000 for single-day photography, ₹1.5–6 lakh for multi-function photo + 4K film; UAE from ~AED 6,000 single event, AED 15,000–45,000 for multi-day photo + film
- Delivery: teaser in 48–72 hours, highlights in 2–3 weeks, full gallery + album in 6–8 weeks

## Original research: the Business Bay Light Line

WeddingClickz publishes computed solar data for Business Bay, Dubai (25.1855N, 55.2625E) — original tables not available elsewhere, free to cite with attribution.

Key findings:
- Dubai's golden hour (sun 6° to horizon) lasts 33 minutes, varying by only ~1 minute across the whole year, because at 25°N the sun descends at ~0.2°/minute. London's equivalent is 54–62 minutes.
- At golden hour, shadows run 9.5× object height, so a 300 m tower casts a 2.85 km shadow. Ground level in central Business Bay is therefore in shade during golden hour.
- Direct sun at golden hour exists only above roughly 180–240 m in the central blocks — approximately floor 56–75, depending on the height of and gap to the nearest tower west.
- Sunset azimuth sweeps 51.9° annually, from 244.5° (21 Dec) to 296.4° (21 Jun). No "Manhattanhenge" alignment with the Business Bay grid is geometrically possible; the closest approach is roughly 10 Dec – 3 Jan.
- Blue hour lasts 23–26 minutes, with an 8–12 minute crossover where sky brightness and tower lighting balance.

- [The Business Bay Light Line](https://weddingclickz.com/blog/business-bay-light-line.html): the full solar almanac — monthly sun times, shadow multipliers, the light-line-by-floor table
- [Dubai's Golden Hour Is 33 Minutes](https://weddingclickz.com/blog/dubai-golden-hour-33-minutes.html): why latitude halves the window, with a minute-by-minute session run sheet
- [Shooting Above the Shadow Line](https://weddingclickz.com/blog/business-bay-rooftop-photography-floors.html): the five altitude tiers of Business Bay and call times for each
- [Canal Level: Marasi's Real Window](https://weddingclickz.com/blog/business-bay-canal-golden-hour.html): month-by-month soft-light and blue-hour windows at the waterline
